role: training and holdout corpus for the deployed tire-force surrogates nn_models/tire_force_static and nn_models/tire_force_rate
contents: train.csv and holdout.csv: uniform-LHS single-tire Chrono SCM rig samples with per-wheel (Fx, Fy, My, sinkage) labels, all six Bekker-Mohr parameters, and both the commanded and the tire-computed operating point
ranges: collector defaults, with mesh spacing pinned to the deployed 0.08 m
note: The kappa_cmd, alpha_cmd, and velocity_cmd columns carry the full commanded operating range, including the +/-0.40 rad slip-angle span the surrogate depends on. Training selects them with --operating-point commanded; the rate-mode inputs are ignored when nn_training/train_variant.py runs in static mode.
